learned_selector: a[href*="/works/"] — Open Library work detail links
operation_rule: Use only links returned by the supplied API; collect candidate URLs before saving because save navigates the browser. Save at most input.max_items (capped at 3), excluding input.exclude_urls.
assumptions: The runtime opens input.start_url before crawl begins.
Returned link URLs are resolved absolute URLs.
A page without matching observed detail links yields no saves.
